flags.message: No. 25-1360 is a conditional, protective petition from the party that prevailed below (Louisiana asks the Court to deny review unless it grants the companion Nathan v. Alamo Heights, No. 26-257). The salience 'state' band assumes a losing State seeking review, so its base rate describes a different population. Its disposition will likely track 26-257, which is not yet distributed. The two cases are not linked by a Vide entry, so record/related/ is empty.
